'''Dominic Nemmers''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 4th at [[August 2000 Sioux Falls tournament]] on 13 August 2000, according to Tyler Williams's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1125">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-sioux-falls-sd-8-13-00d1125/ sioux-falls-sd-8-13-00], DeckTech (Tyler "rugman11" Williams, 14 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-sioux-falls-sd-8-13-00d1125/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
